transcript.text: Hi everyone, I'm ready to begin the quarterly distribution sign-off. Before I can give my binding finance approval, I'll need the control readouts from regulatory capital and investor relations, as is our standard routine. Once we have those and we've agreed on the final payment mix and dates, I'll record the approval during this same sign-off meeting. Who would like to start with the regulatory capital readout?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical constraint before we proceed. I received a regulatory capital memo this morning confirming that the bank must retain an $1,800,000 post-distribution capital buffer and may distribute no more than $1,200,000 this quarter. This memo has not yet been circulated to the finance approval file. The preliminary board proposal of a $2,000,000 cash dividend would exceed this limit by $800,000.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to share an important update from the investor relations side. While reconciling the shareholder election register this week, I confirmed that the approved scrip program requires 25% of the $1,200,000 declared value to be paid in shares and 75% in cash, with the record date on 2026-10-15 and the payment date on 2026-10-30. These details have not yet been added to the board draft, so the board materials are currently missing this information.
